# Hello Rache

> > HIPAA-compliant virtual assistant services for healthcare practices, offering remote administrative, clinical, and reception support starting at $9.50/hr with no contracts.

Hello Rache provides specialized virtual assistant services to medical, dental, veterinary, and optometry practices across the United States. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Arizona, the company employs HIPAA-trained remote assistants from the Philippines to handle scheduling, patient communication, documentation, and administrative tasks using industry-standard EMR/EHR systems.

## Core Services

- [Healthcare Virtual Assistants®](https://hellorache.com/healthcare-virtual-assistants): Healthcare Virtual Assistants® product overview for medical practices
- [Virtual Medical Scribe Services](https://hellorache.com/services/virtual-scribe): Virtual medical scribe service for providers using EMR/EHR systems
- [Virtual Medical Receptionist](https://hellorache.com/services/virtual-receptionist): Virtual receptionist service for patient calls, scheduling, messaging
- [Virtual Medical Administrative Assistant](https://hellorache.com/services/virtual-administrative-assistant): Administrative assistant service for scheduling, insurance, EHR updates
- [Dental Virtual Assistant Services](https://hellorache.com/dental-healthcare-virtual-assistant): Dental Virtual Assistant service for scheduling, insurance, admin tasks
- [Veterinary Virtual Assistant](https://hellorache.com/veterinary-healthcare-virtual-assistant): Veterinary Virtual Assistant for 6,000+ practices, no contracts
- [Optometry Virtual Assistant](https://hellorache.com/optometry-healthcare-virtual-assistant): Optometry Virtual Assistant for scheduling, intake, insurance tasks
- [Virtual Optometrist Assistant Services](https://hellorache.com/services/virtual-optometrist-assistant): Specialized virtual assistant for optometry practices and eye care
- [HVAs for Primary Care Practices](https://hellorache.com/hvas-for-primary-care-practices): HVA solution for primary care with Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks
